name: Dog of Dracula 2: Cyber Monogatari
source:
The conclusion of The Groomer Duology. Inspired by an introspective visit to Best Buy, Team Batsu's visual novel sequel explores a rebel's struggles with technophobia, consumerism, and his strained relationship with a cyberpup.

[From [url=http://dogofdracula.comyr.com/]official site[/url]]
translation:
《美容师二部曲》的完结篇。Team Batsu在一次前往百思买、引发自我反思的经历中获得灵感，制作了这部视觉小说续作。故事探讨了一位叛逆者与技术恐惧、消费主义之间的斗争，以及他与一只赛博小狗之间紧张的关系。

（摘自[url=http://dogofdracula.comyr.com/]官网[/url]）
